conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 151 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 146 | 250 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 7.6 | 3.8 | 250 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 10.2 | 5.1 | 250 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
